s.en: Create groups for this person's abilities (like "combat", "healing", "travel"); after switching with the "ability groups" button on the ability bar, only that group's abilities are shown.\n\nThe ability bar currently shows:

s.zh: [DND边缘大陆] 技能分组按钮：
还没有分组。左键或右键打开分组设置：新建分组（如「战斗」「治疗」「赶路」），给每个能力勾选所在的组。
s.en: No groups yet. Left- or right-click to open group settings: create groups (like "combat", "healing", "travel") and tick which group each ability belongs to.

s.en: → all).\nRight-click: open group settings (create, rename and delete groups, assign abilities, pick the current group directly).

s.zh: \n\n选了某一组时，技能栏只显示这一组的能力；其他按钮（征召、攻击等）不受影响。不在当前组里的能力照常冷却，开了自动施放的照样会自动放。
s.en: \n\nWith a group selected, the ability bar only shows that group's abilities; other buttons (draft, attack, etc.) are unaffected. Abilities not in the current group still cool down as usual, and those with autocast on still cast automatically.

s.zh: 。技能栏上的「技能分组」按钮左键切换下一组、右键打开这里。只影响显示：不在当前组里的能力照常冷却，开了自动施放的照样会自动放。一个能力可以在多个组里。
s.en: . The "ability groups" button on the ability bar switches to the next group with left-click and opens this window with right-click. It only affects display: abilities outside the current group still cool down as usual, and those with autocast on still cast automatically. An ability can be in several groups.
